business_definition: Revenue returned for each marketing dollar spent.
quality_dependencies: spend non-null, revenue reconciled, campaign mapping current
interpretation_notes: Use booked revenue for executive reporting; platform conversions are a diagnostic input.

business_definition: Marketing spend required to create one closed-won conversion.
quality_dependencies: closed-won conversions loaded, no orphan conversion spike
interpretation_notes: Do not compare CAC across channels without checking conversion lag.

business_definition: Gross margin generated per marketing dollar spent.
interpretation_notes: Preferred for budget decisions when margin varies by product.

business_definition: Share of captured leads that become closed-won conversions.
target_or_guardrail: Stable or improving month over month
quality_dependencies: lead IDs unique, conversion joins valid
interpretation_notes: A falling rate may be caused by source mix, handoff issues, or late-arriving revenue.

business_definition: Share of journey records with usable attribution identifiers.
quality_dependencies: attribution_id populated, session campaign mapping valid
interpretation_notes: Coverage below target should be shown before ROI conclusions.

business_definition: Actual performance divided by monthly business target.
quality_dependencies: target file loaded, month alignment valid
interpretation_notes: Spend attainment alone is not success; pair it with revenue and lead attainment.

business_definition: Expected revenue efficiency over the next three planning months.
interpretation_notes: Uses a simple rolling trend for local scenario planning; replace with a production forecasting service if needed.

business_definition: Operating-health score for source reliability, quality, attribution, and BI readiness.
quality_dependencies: source health, quality, action center, reconciliation marts
interpretation_notes: Use this as the release gate for executive-facing dashboard changes.

business_definition: Count of P0/P1 actions requiring owner-team follow-up.
formula: count actions where priority in P0/P1
quality_dependencies: action center generated from quality, forecast, anomaly, and pacing marts
interpretation_notes: Prioritize operational trust issues before budget-expansion decisions.
